blocking: [opus-for-opus2] Open-redirect gap in the return-path rule: A/project/docs/architecture.md:41 "It is honored only when it is a same-origin relative path (starts with a single `/`, not `//`, and has no scheme)." A value made of a slash followed by a backslash and a host (e.g. next=%2F%5Cevil.example) passes all three checks, and browsers treat slash-backslash as `//`, so a crafted /auth link would send a freshly signed-in user off-site. The rule needs to reject backslashes or resolve the URL against the app origin and compare origins (D does both). (withdrawn)
